payload.body_they: The people {{Name}} is attracted to often make their own values easier to understand. Closeness shows them what kind of affection they enjoy, what they want to share, and what stops working once another person's choices affect their time, money, attention, or future. Attraction can be completely genuine without answering the compatibility question. What happens after two people choose each other tells {{Name}} what the relationship can actually support.
